title: Wither Mace
description: Wither mace is a craftable mace that grants the player the ability to use their offhand bind to shoot a wither skull with a 10 second cooldown
body:
Wither Mace
The ultimate utility weapon for modern combat.

The Wither Mace isn't just a heavy hitter—it's a tactical projectile launcher. By infusing the raw power of a Mace with the volatile essence of the Wither, players can now dominate the battlefield from both close quarters and a distance.

Offhand to toggle ability
